speaker: Host
text: Welcome to HealthBrief — your weekly five-minute update from the clinical team. I'm joined today by our quality improvement lead. Good to have you.

speaker: Guest
text: Great to be here. Good week to be talking about this stuff actually.

speaker: Host
text: Let's start with the headline. Hand hygiene compliance — ninety-four percent. Put that in context for me.

speaker: Guest
text: So anything above ninety is considered gold standard. We've been sitting in the mid-eighties for the better part of two years. This is a genuine step change. The gel dispensers at every entry point made a real difference.

speaker: Host
text: What shifted the behaviour though? Because the dispensers have been talked about for a while.

speaker: Guest
text: Honestly? Visibility. When staff see the numbers on the board every morning, it becomes real. It's not a policy anymore — it's a score. People respond to that.

speaker: Host
text: Flu season next. What do staff need to know?

speaker: Guest
text: Free vaccination clinic, every Tuesday, Level Two, eight till four. Ten minutes of your time. And I'll say it plainly — this protects your patients, not just you. Immunocompromised patients cannot protect themselves. We can.

speaker: Host
text: Strong point. Finally — the isolation protocol update.

speaker: Guest
text: New flowchart, live on the intranet from the fifth of May. Your charge nurse has been briefed. If you're unsure in the moment, that's your first call — not Google, not a colleague in the corridor. Your charge nurse.

speaker: Host
text: Clear. Thanks for being straight about it. That's your HealthBrief for this week — we'll be back same time next Tuesday.
